# ADR-3228: AWS logging: S3 access logging disablement for trail bucket 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Access logs detect unauthorized reads of trails.

## Decision

Trail buckets MUST NOT allow an S3 access logging disablement for trail bucket 4 (AWS-logging-4) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Logging buckets are separately locked down.
